kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تحتضروا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَضِرُوا (taḥtaḍirū) /taħ.ta.dˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# تُحْتَضَرُوا (tuḥtaḍarū) /tuħ.ta.dˤa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
